episodes.title: Out of the Past
episodes.summary: Waking up in a new body 250 years after his death, Takeshi Kovacs discovers he's been resurrected to help a titan of industry solve his own murder.

episodes.title: Fallen Angel
episodes.summary: While Kovacs tracks down a man who sent Bancroft a death threat, Lt. Ortega bends the rules to keep tabs on his whereabouts.

episodes.title: In a Lonely Place
episodes.summary: Kovacs recruits an unlikely partner to watch his back during a banquet at the Bancroft home, where Ortega oversees the night's grisly entertainment.

episodes.title: Force of Evil
episodes.summary: Tortured by his captor, Kovacs taps into his Envoy training to survive. Ortega springs a surprise on her family for Dia de los Muertos.

episodes.title: The Wrong Man
episodes.summary: After learning his sleeve's identity, Kovacs demands the full story from Ortega. A tip from Poe leads to a major breakthrough in the Bancroft case.

episodes.title: Man with My Face
episodes.summary: With Orgeta's fate hanging in the balance, Kovacs drops a bombshell on the Bancrofts. Later, he comes face to face with an unsettling opponent.

episodes.title: Nora Inu
episodes.summary: As Kovacs reconnects with a figure from his past, his tangled history with the Protectorate, the Uprising and Quell plays out in flashbacks.

episodes.title: Clash by Night
episodes.summary: His world rocked, Kovacs requests a dipper to help him sew up the Bancroft case quickly. Ortega races to identify the mystery woman from Fight Drome.

episodes.title: Rage in Heaven
episodes.summary: After a devastating rampage, Kovacs and his allies hatch a bold -- and very risky -- scheme to infiltrate Head in the Clouds.

episodes.title: The Killers
episodes.summary: As a cornered Kovacs braces for a final showdown in the sky, a new hero emerges and more buried secrets come to light.

episodes.title: Phantom Lady
episodes.summary: Thirty years after the Bancroft case, a Meth tracks down Kovacs to offer him a job, a high-tech sleeve and a chance to see Quellcrist Falconer again.

episodes.title: Payment Deferred
episodes.summary: As Col. Carrera takes charge of the murder investigation, Kovacs sets out to find Axley's bounty hunter, and Poe's memory glitches worsen.

episodes.title: Nightmare Alley
episodes.summary: Kovacs contends with ghosts from his past as he's tortured by Carrera. Poe seeks help from a fellow AI. Trepp gets a lead on the man she's after.

episodes.title: Shadow of a Doubt
episodes.summary: While the planet celebrates Harlan's Day, Kovacs hatches an escape plan, Quell pieces together fragments of her life, and Poe faces a reckoning.

episodes.title: I Wake Up Screaming
episodes.summary: Carrera sends his secret weapon on a deadly mission. Kovacs and Trepp smuggle Quell out of the city. Poe takes a risky trip into virtual reality.

episodes.title: Bury Me Dead
episodes.summary: As Quell reconnects to her past at Stronghold, she leads the clone into an underground chamber teeming with secrets. Gov. Harlan shows her true colors.

episodes.title: Experiment Perilous
episodes.summary: When Quell's sleeve begins to shut down, Poe and Ms. Dig send her into VR, where Kovacs finally learns the truth about her deadly rampages.

episodes.title: Broken Angels
episodes.summary: With the fate of the whole planet on the line, Kovacs, Quell and team race to find Konrad Harlan and stop a catastrophic blast of Angelfire.
